about: Basic tasks with weekday and 'next week' deadlines, a decision, a parked idea and an open question
title: Product launch sync
transcript: Thanks everyone, let's lock the launch plan today.
If we drop calendar sync from version one, we can ship on January 12.
Okay, agreed. Calendar sync moves to version two and we launch on January 12.
Maya, I need the API documentation finished by Friday.
Sure, I'll have the API docs done by Friday.
Jordan, please book the stakeholder demo for next week.
Maybe one day we could build a desktop app, but not now.
Who owns the pricing page copy? Nobody knows yet, we'll figure it out later.

about: ASAP becomes urgent with a real date; a speech-to-text typo in a name (Mya); several owners
title: Payment incident call
transcript: The payment bug is breaking checkout again for card payments.
Mya, please fix the payment bug as soon as possible, it is urgent.
Alex, can you update the status page today?
Yes, I'll update the status page.
Jordan, write the incident report by Thursday.

about: In-room follow-up questions; a later answer changes the decision (final outcome wins)
title: Release planning
transcript: Good morning everyone, welcome to the release planning meeting in the main hall.
Our plan was to launch the mobile beta on December 15th.
Sorry, quick question from the back. Is the payment bug fixed already?
Good question. No, the payment bug is not fixed yet, so we will move the beta to December 22nd.
And will Android and iPhone launch together?
Yes, both platforms launch together on the 22nd.
Alex, can you update the release notes by Friday?
